instruction.text: Select the ship to learn about the HMT Empire Windrush

feedback.end: The HMT Empire Windrush was a big passenger ship. In 1948, it was used to carry British Caribbean migrants to the UK.

instruction.text: Select each person to hear their reason for coming to Britain. Drag them to the correct group.

feedback.finish: There were many reasons people chose to travel to the UK, but the most common reason was for work.

atoms.sound: I was in the RAF during the war. I want to go to Britain to rejoin.
There’s no work for builders in Jamaica, but I’ve heard Britain needs lots of new buildings.
I have heard a lot about how good Britain is, I want to see for myself.
Pay is better in the UK and I would like to send money back home.

instruction.text: Select the correct part of the image to learn more.

feedback.correct: The HMT Empire Windrush carried around 1,000 people from the Caribbean to Britain.
Many of the people migrating had served in the British army during World War 2, so they were already familiar with some elements of the UK.
On the 22nd of June 1948, the Windrush arrived in Essex. All of the migrants arriving from then until 1971 are known as the Windrush generation

atoms.a: Many migrants had already been to the UK.
